name: Events
tagline: Pack lists before the market, sales logged once it is over
description: For small sellers working markets and pop-ups, this desk covers both ends of the day: a merchandise pack list built before each event so nothing gets left behind, then a record of what actually sold afterward. That second half is what lets in-person sales reach the same books as your online channels.
author: RichGarrick
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
